title: The failure
text: 💥 The failure What broke The Week 6 pipeline job (Jenkins builds the WAR, then scp s it to the Docker EC2 as dockeradmin ) failed instantly — before checkout, before any shell step ran. title: The investigation, step by step
text: 🔍 The investigation, step by step Hypothesis 1: the binary is missing — wrong "Not an ssh-agent executable path" reads like openssh-clients was never installed. Checking as root found the binary just fine — which disproves nothing, because root's login shell is not the Jenkins process. Remember: a service resolves commands from the enviro ⌁ which ssh-agent · sudo -u jenkins -s /bin/bash -c 'echo $PATH; which ssh-agent' · grep -i '^Plugin-Version' \ · <com...sshagent.SSHAgentBuildWrapper plugin="ssh-agent@416...">

title: Root cause and fix
text: 🎯 Root cause and fix Root cause SSH Agent plugin 416 added an optional "Executable" override. Saving the job with the field blank serialized <executable></executable> , and the plugin treats the empty string as a configured path rather than "use the PATH". An empty string has no filename, so the ssh-agent(.exe) filename check throws. Reme ⌁ ""  →  toSSHAgentPath("")  →  no filename · /usr/bin/ssh-agent

title: Lessons worth keeping
text: 🧠 Lessons worth keeping The plugin was optional all along The lab's deploy step is a plain scp in an Execute-shell block. That needs no wrapper — only a key pair owned by the jenkins user, trusted by dockeradmin on the Docker host, verified by hand before touching Jenkins.
